choiceQuote: Square Off is one of my favorites. Get upgrades for you and the boss. Choose wisely, or you may lead yourself to your own demise.
title: Square Off
description: Build your arsenal. Choose how your enemy evolves. Survive one more round.
controls: Keyboard & mouse recommended · touch controls available

title: Square Off 2
description: Upgrade yourself and the boss. Dash through ten rounds, unlock 36 characters, and take on Endless or the Practice Workshop.
choiceQuote: A sequel to Square Off, with more upgrades, fun, and chaos.
coverAlt: Comic-book concept art of a turquoise jetpack square facing a huge coral mechanical boss.
controls: Keyboard & mouse · A/D move · Space thrust · Shift dash · E utility

title: Backrooms: For Science
description: Explore the Backrooms and study its entities. Survive your shifts, meet your research quota, and spend your pay on better gear.
controls: WASD · Mouse · E to interact

choiceQuote: Rustbound is for people who found Stellar Forge too easy. Addicting, but requires brainpower.
title: Rustbound
description: Build a spacecraft, travel between worlds, and turn distant planets into home.
controls: Keyboard & mouse recommended

title: Meridian Space Program
description: Design rockets, run science experiments, and explore space. Use your discoveries to unlock better parts and build more capable rockets.
choiceQuote: A game about making rockets, doing science experiments, and exploring.
coverAlt: A detailed white rocket tilting to the right above Earth’s blue upper atmosphere.
controls: Mouse: build · WASD / QE steer · Shift / Ctrl throttle · Space stage

title: Slide Between
description: Race a robot down a winding slide suspended between floating doors. Jump off anywhere, land on lower sections, and turn risky shortcuts into a winning lead.
controls: Drag to steer · tap Jump · A / D, W / S & Space on keyboard

choiceQuote: Neon Slip is good for a quick game or if you need to be occupied for a few minutes, also playable on phone.
title: Neon Slip
description: Dodge the gates, collect sparks, and beat your best. Unlock a ship that feels like yours.
controls: Touch & keyboard controls

choiceQuote: Stellar Forge is a nice cross between Cookie Clicker and space exploration. Keeps you hooked.
title: Stellar Forge
description: Explore your own corner of the cosmos and build something among the stars.
controls: Keyboard & mouse recommended

choiceQuote: The Undercroft is a fast-paced, grappling action game with plenty of bosses, challenges, and enemies to face.
title: The Undercroft
description: Grapple through endless brick chambers. Find new weapons, claim upgrades, and descend deeper.
controls: Mouse & touch controls

title: Car Spleef
choiceQuote: A quick, fun spin on spleef where you drive cars instead of running around and jumping.
description: Bump your rivals, drift over crumbling tiles, and be the last car standing.
controls: Arrow keys / WASD · Space to drift · touch controls

title: Car Spleef 3D
description: The floor falls away. Get behind the wheel in full 3D, drift past three rivals, and switch between cockpit and chase cameras across 30 crumbling arenas.
choiceQuote: A spin on the original Car Spleef where the entire game is 3D, and some new features are added.
controls: WASD / arrows · Space drift · C camera · P pause

title: Crazy Sort
description: The Boomkins are loose and their fuses are lit. Drag each colorful bomb into its matching pen before time runs out. Take on five difficulties, from Easy to Hyperchaos.
choiceQuote: A game with many difficulties about sorting bombs into the correct pens.
controls: Mouse / trackpad: drag to sort · Esc pause · M mute

title: Arcade Tycoon
description: Grow a corner arcade into The Grand Arcade across six venues. 17 attractions, picky visitors with real needs, staff, events and upgrades.
choiceQuote: A fun tycoon game about building your arcade empire. Good for slightly longer sessions.
controls: Mouse / touch · build, inspect & manage · R rotates · Space pauses

title: Ducks vs Dogs
description: Defend a little pond with an unlikely flock. Meet 30 ducks in Campaign, or hold off the pack in Endless.
choiceQuote: A tower defense game where ducks must defend against dogs!
controls: Mouse / touch · choose & place ducks

title: Ducks vs. Dogs 2
description: Defend the pond in cartoony 3D. Collect 34 ducks, unlock five shops, and choose your flock across six worlds.
choiceQuote: A game where ducks must defend against dogs, in 3D!
controls: Mouse: choose & place ducks · 1–8 cards · Q Quack Power · R remove · Space pause
coverAlt: A cartoon chef duck faces a mischievous dog beside a pond, under the Ducks vs. Dogs 2 title.

title: Deep Signal
description: An endless descent into a living ocean. Recover every salvage pod, dive deeper, and survive what waits below.
controls: WASD / arrows · Space sonar · touch pods / E recover
choiceQuote: Dive deeper and deeper to discover new artifacts with mysterious creatures along the way.

title: Cargo Swing
description: Work a swinging crane over a moving ship. Stack cargo, balance its weight, and see how long you can keep everything aboard.
controls: A / D or arrows · Space drops cargo · P pauses
choiceQuote: Stack up cargo on a ship, but don't let it fall!

title: Pocket Heist
description: Ten chapters, 100 procedurally built jobs, then endless heists. Dodge guards, cameras, lasers and dogs, crack vaults, and gear up between jobs.
controls: WASD / arrows · Shift sneaks · E interacts · Q smoke · F decoy · C EMP
choiceQuote: Quietly sneak around cops while grabbing precious loot.
A puzzle game about hitting a few stars with a bouncing ball. Fun for a quick little arcade game.
title: Ricochet Club
description: Eight clubs, 80 tables, then endless. Bank a marble off rails, bumpers, glass, portals, gravity wells and switches to collect every star.
controls: Drag to aim & set power, release to shoot · arrows aim · Space shoots

choiceQuote: A puzzle game much like Block Blast about putting blocks into place. Filling a row or column up destroys it.
title: Parcel Panic
description: Pack parcels into the van and dispatch full rows and columns. Endless Classic, 60 delivery routes with goals, and a Daily route — no timer.
controls: Drag or click parcels · R / right-click rotates · H, B, N tools

choiceQuote: A spooky anomaly game about spotting weird anomalies as a night guard of a museum.
title: Odd Hours
description: Eight cameras, seven nights and endless Overtime. Spot missing, moved, extra and altered objects — and things that should not be there — then file the right report.
controls: 1–8 cameras · Space archive photo · M V X A I L W report
